title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
To bring about the realisation of human rights for poor and marginalised men and women affected by high inequality, human rights violations and violence in seven conflict or post-conflict countries by addressing issues of governance, tackling violence, building peace and promoting equality for all, particularly gender equality. Outcome 2.1: Communities and HRDs have been protected and are resilient to threats of violence, and are tackling the causes of violence, in particular impunity.
Outcome 2.2: Civil society, including partners and victims are able to influence the peace process and take part in the implementation of the peace accords, ensuring victims' rights to truth, justice, reparation and guarantees of non-repetition. Objective 2: Marginalised women and men facing violence have greater safety, security and resilience, and inclusive peace building initiatives contribute to lasting justice.
